productAnalyticsDoubleCharge.rule: 官方 AI Observability basics 明确：所有以 $ai_ 开头的事件按 AI Observability 计费，不按 Product Analytics 事件计费。
productAnalyticsDoubleCharge.evidenceOrigin: Current official MCP docs-search result; explicit product contract, not an inference from shared events storage.
productAnalyticsDoubleCharge.scope: Applies to the same $ai_ event. Separate pageviews/custom non-$ai_ events and separately emitted OTLP records still use their own meters.
productAnalyticsDoubleCharge.instanceBoundary: This documented rule does not establish this organization's exact settled invoice or verify case-specific ledger amounts.

semantics.otlpPlusAi: If a generation emits an OTLP span and an AI event, those are two separate records measured in GB and AI events. The estimate accounts for each actual admitted signal; it does not equate them or assume one substitutes for the other.
semantics.credits: Replay Vision, PostHog AI and Self-driving have different published pricing bases. Do not apply the PostHog AI500-credit allowance or20percent inference markup to Vision or a scout-run count without a specific applicable billing contract.
semantics.scouts: Enabled daily scouts do not imply a fixed per-run fee. Current Self-driving docs price actionable PR outcomes; Inbox-only reports are not automatically a billable PR.
semantics.actualProviderCost: Claude/Codex subscription or provider charges are outside these PostHog telemetry fees. $ai_total_cost_usd observations are not a verified per-call subscription invoice.

frozenMeasurement.preservedDifferences: Organization snapshot and project/day series are not reconciled. Combined373 MB differs from components324+47=371 MB. No ingestion-delay, rounding or case-attribution assumption fills the gap.
frozenMeasurement.attribution: No organization/project-wide usage growth is assigned to this case. Formal ACME cases remain0 in this preparation.

formulas.notation: For each tier [a,b,r], contribution is r*max(0,min(x,b)-a); b=null means infinity. Sum tiers to get F_p(x). Free allowance is encoded by the first paid lower bound.
formulas.totalIncremental: Estimated case cost = sum_p[F_p(U_org,p + delta_case,p) - F_p(U_org,p)] + actual custom-retention GB-months*0.05. U and delta must use the same product unit/billing period.
formulas.products: Use logs_and_traces, ai_observability, web_session_replay and actually requested Vision/other paid features. If ordinary non-$ai_ Product Analytics events are emitted, add that product's own billable delta; do not add the same $ai_ event again.
formulas.logsExact: delta_GB = attributable admitted logs_and_traces_MB /1000, using this project's recorded display_divisor1000.
formulas.logsScenarioFromCounts: If calibrated billing-size coefficients exist: delta_GB_run ≈ (S_run*mean_billable_MB_per_span + L_run*mean_billable_MB_per_log)/1000. S/L are actually retained/admitted signals. Coefficients are presently unknown; raw JSON/OTLP wire bytes are not assumed equal to billed storage bytes.
formulas.aiDelta: delta_AI_run = actual billable AI-event increment attributable to the run; generations + any additional $ai_ records, not assumed equal to run count or model calls.
formulas.replayDelta: delta_Replay_run = actual newly billable web recordings for the case, not number of snapshots or repeated playback reads.
formulas.visionDelta: delta_VisionCredits = sum(new successful billable observations * frozen model credits). Two new standard Gemini3Flash observations:2*5=10credits, nominal10*0.01=$0.10 before free allocation; not a measured charge. Cached reuse/reservations are not assumed newly settled charges.
formulas.posthogAi: F_PostHogAI(C)=0.01*max(C-500,0), only for features billed under that published credit product; actual per-request credits remain unknown.
formulas.selfDriving: F_PR(P)=15*max(P-3,0), only when the documented billable actionable-PR outcome occurs. Do not multiply scout runs by this rate.
formulas.freePlanBoundary: These are PAYG list-price or conditional scenario formulas, not this free organization's actual invoice. Above its active free limits, ingestion may stop instead of buying overage. Below allowance a modeled marginal tariff can be zero without converting null returned USD into an observed $0 charge.
formulas.forecastBoundary: No monthly forecast or per-run numeric cost is computed because real-case increments and billable span/log size are not yet measured.

prParagraphZh: 按2026-11-09官方公开价，APM/Tracing与Logs合并按摄入GB计量（10GB/月免费，首付费档$0.25/GB）；AI Observability为100k事件/月免费、首档$0.00035/事件，Web Replay为5k录屏/月免费、首档$0.005/录屏。官方MCP文档明确$ai_事件只按AI Observability计费，不再按Product Analytics事件收费。最终按真实case各产品增量代入 F(组织已用量+case增量)-F(组织已用量)，不把组织总增长归因本案例。11:47–11:49冻结回执仍为free，组织用量447MB/1117AI事件/18录屏，USD字段null保留unknown。两次标准Replay Vision仅作10credits、未扣免费额$0.10的名义估算；当前2500credits免费额度是限时安排。巡检按现公开Self-driving结果定价（首3个PR免费、其后$15/PR），没有可套用于每次scout运行的固定单价。以上是公开list-price估算，不是实例逐次实付或Claude/Codex订阅账单。
